explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/743: 'Gyárfás and Lehel proved that this holds if all but at most 2 of the trees are stars'. The Lean statement: trees T k for 2 ≤ k ≤ n such that for some indices a, b every T k with k ≠ a, b is a star (starGraph c) pack into K_n. Allowing a = b or indices outside the range covers 'at most 2'. Faithful.
